versions.changelog:
pi-tui 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces component-based terminal UI framework with differential rendering for flicker-free, interactive CLIs
- Implements synchronized output (CSI 2026) and overlay support to prevent flicker and support dialogs/menus
- Includes built-in components: TUI container, Box, Text, TruncatedText, Input, Editor, Markdown, Loader, SelectList, SettingsList, Spacer, Image
- Out-of-the-box support for input method editors (IME), autocomplete, and Kitty keyboard protocol
- Provides clear component/focus interfaces, core usage docs, and practical gotchas for smooth integration
